process_description: CANONICAL create a free-form journal entry. Tenants log conversations, incidents, repair requests, and notes with a title, content, timestamp, and optional tags. CANONICAL list of journal entries for a user. Returns entries sorted by occurrence time, newest first, with optional filters and pagination. CANONICAL get a single journal entry by ID. Enforces ownership. CANONICAL update a journal entry. Enforces ownership. CANONICAL delete a journal entry. Enforces ownership. CANONICAL dashboard summary of journal entries. Returns total count, urgent count, and the most recent entries.
